notes: Manual section 5.3: 'The base*hazer uses two channels on your desk! First Channel = Pump, second Channel = Fan.' Matches repo map (ch1 Pump, ch2 Fan). Manual gives percentages, not DMX value breakpoints, so the 0-255 ranges are a linear reading. Dimensions from manual are the flightcase: 59.4 x 54 x 18.5 cm closed, 41.4 x 54 x 18.5 cm open (recorded open: L=414, W=540, H=185). Weight is NOT in the original manual; 18 kg is the Base Hazer Pro figure (same 1500 W / 5 l / Amptown flightcase form factor, also the Weight in the repo's Hazebase@Base_Hazer_Pro@rev1.gdtf) - guessed. Repo already has Hazebase@Base_Hazer_Pro@rev1.gdtf (Pro model) whose 2Chan mode is ch1 Haze (pump), ch2 Blower (fan) - same layout, so it is a usable stand-in. OFL has base-hazer-pro only. No GDTF-share entry for the non-Pro base*hazer located (site requires login). Also supports 0-10 V analogue (pump only) and an internal timer; DMX takes priority.
